intro: Professionals and everyday users convert gallons (uk) (gal (UK)) to liters (L) when working across imperial and metric standards in culinary recipe scaling, beverage bottling, laboratory reagent preparation, and fluid tank capacity sizing. One gallon (uk imperial) equals 4.54609 liters, while 1 liter equals 0.219969 gallons (uk). Whether you are verifying volume & liquid specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US Customary vs. British Imperial Liquid Volume Trap
items: US Customary and UK Imperial liquid units share identical names but have different physical volumes: 1 US Gallon is 3.78541 L (128 US fl oz), whereas 1 UK Imperial Gallon is 4.54609 L (160 Imp fl oz) — a 20.1% difference.

Similarly, 1 US Pint contains 16 US fluid ounces (473.18 mL), while 1 British Imperial Pint contains 20 Imperial fluid ounces (568.26 mL). Always verify whether your recipe, pump datasheet, or vehicle spec sheet uses US or UK standards.

faqs.question: How many liters (L) are in 1 gallon (uk imperial) (gal (UK))?
faqs.answer: There are 4.54609 liters (L) in 1 gallon (uk imperial) (gal (UK)), which rounds to 4.5461 L for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 liter equals 0.219969 gallons (uk).

faqs.question: How do I convert gallons (uk) to liters (gal (UK) to L)?
faqs.answer: To convert gallons (uk) to liters, use the formula: L = gal (UK) × 4.54609. For example, converting 5 gal (UK) gives 22.7305 L.

faqs.question: What is 5 gallons (uk) in liters?
faqs.answer: 5 gallons (uk) (gal (UK)) equals exactly 22.7305 liters (L) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
